hourly_azkar.text_en: There is no god but Allah
Glory and praise be to Allah
Glory be to Allah, the Almighty
I seek forgiveness from Allah, the Almighty, and I repent to Him

hourly_azkar.text_ar: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
hourly_azkar.text_en: There is no power or strength except with Allah

hourly_azkar.text_ar: اللهم صلِّ وسلِّم على نبينا محمد
hourly_azkar.text_en: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad
Allah is sufficient for me, and He is the best Disposer of affairs

hourly_azkar.text_ar: الله الله ربي لا أشرك به شيئًا
hourly_azkar.text_en: Allah, Allah is my Lord; I associate nothing with Him

hourly_azkar.text_ar: وأفوض أمري إلى الله إن الله بصير بالعباد
hourly_azkar.text_en: I entrust my affair to Allah; surely Allah sees His servants
